bcb35e44c3a7505507ed369832a577d874faebed.summary: This is an archived U.S. Department of Justice video landing page, dated 2022-04-06. Its title says the Attorney General announced enforcement actions to disrupt and prosecute Russian criminal activity. The captured text holds only navigation, the title, the date and topic labels (Cybercrime, Countering Nation-State Threats). It describes no actors, tools, techniques, victims or figures, so it is not treated as a threat report and no facts are recorded.
